lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Good day, Tenerife — you're listening to Radio Tenerify, and it is a gorgeous Wednesday out there.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: It really is! Twenty-three degrees, clear skies, not a cloud in sight — classic Tenerife summer doing exactly what it's supposed to do.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Perfect beach weather. Now, before we get too settled into holiday mode, we do want to briefly acknowledge a story from a few weeks back — a British man lost his life following a violent incident in the Las Verónicas area. A sobering reminder to stay safe on the nights out, folks.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Absolutely. Please look after yourselves and each other out there. Now — on a much brighter note, Santa Cruz has a huge weekend lined up!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Yes! The Urban Beach Festival is this Saturday at the Puerto de Santa Cruz, with Beéle bringing his Borondo Tour to the island. And then Sunday, Kapo makes his very first Tenerife appearance over at the Palmetum car park.

lines.speaker: Mia
lines.text: Two big nights, back to back — Santa Cruz is delivering this weekend!

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Check the links on our website for tickets. Until then, enjoy that sunshine — you've earned it.
